articles.title: A Missile That Runs on a Tiny Nuclear Reactor? Yep, and It's Flying Over the Arctic!
articles.summary: Russia tested a nuclear-powered missile called Skyfall that flew in loops for hours. Scientists say it likely spews radiation as it flies, putting people near the test site at risk. The missile could fly almost forever, making it a scary new weapon.

articles.title: Black Rain Falls on Moscow After Huge Drone Attack Hits Oil Refinery!
articles.summary: After Ukraine sent nearly 200 drones toward Moscow, a refinery was hit and black oily specks rained down on parts of the city. Russia says it shot down almost 1,000 drones nationwide. The attack was Ukraine's answer to a Russian strike on Kyiv.

articles.title: Supreme Court Says Marijuana User Can Own Guns—Here's Why
articles.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that the government can't automatically ban a marijuana user from owning guns. The case involved a Texas man who used marijuana every other day. The court said the law was too vague, but it didn't say all drug users can have guns.
